tweet.text: We work to maintain our independence from frontier AI companies, especially as our risk assessments become more consequential. We have not accepted funding from these companies, and we do not accept donations made by or at the direction of their staff. However, frontier AI companies currently provide a significant amount of free tokens for our evaluations, research, and engineering.
